findings: Both implementations use RMSNorm and adaLN shift/scale/gates; unconditional configurations supply time conditioning, not a dedicated raw noisy-image global statistics encoder.
cstft_jit RPCAHead optionally FiLM-modulates GroupNorm outputs; that feature is separate from the main CelebA/Arc2Face configurations.
JiT predicts clean x directly, trains velocity-space MSE with linear flow z=t*x+(1-t)*noise, logit-normal t and Heun/Euler sampling. It is not merely a transformer replacement for epsilon DDPM.
ImageStats applies dataset-level per-channel mean/std with inverse transform; it does not discard per-image brightness or contrast.

CelebA execplan records a strong early output-conv effect that largely shrinks at 30000 updates. Patch8 had higher final validation loss than patch4. These are repository-recorded results, not rerun here.
Reference CelebA: 130.4M parameters, 30000*1024=30.72M image draws. Current baseline: 6.337M, 5000*32=160000 draws. Exposure differs by 192x, so prior visual quality cannot isolate architecture.

Applied here: scale/shift in U-Net residual blocks; added noisy-image global statistics plus pooled features as a zero-initialized residual condition. Kept epsilon loss and sampler fixed to isolate conditioning.
